page.overview:
Who is Al Azif?

Al Azif is a fictional entity in the Demonbane Mythos. The character was originally created by Jin Haganeya, appearing as one of the main heroines for the visual novel Deus Machina Demonbane.

Al Azif is the humanoid avatar of the Necronomicon, taking the form of a petite young girl with silver hair and jade green eyes in a white dress. Behind her are a pair of small, floating book-like wings composed of grimoire pages. In Magius Style, she accompanies her master in a much smaller, chibi-like form with a black outfit replacing her white dress, while her head grows a pair of black wings that can change into a hat.

As a thousand-year-old grimoire, Al has a high sense of pride and can be arrogant at times. She clashed with Hadou Ruri on multiple occasions because the latter could not tolerate her personality and called her an old book, although their relationship was drastically improved as the story progressed.

Regardless, Al is fundamentally a kind-hearted person who cares deeply about the well-being of those who are close to her. In the past, Al has gone through many different masters, where every single one of them suffered a horrific death after battles against evil forces. This put heavy burden on her as she felt a tremendous guilt over their demise. After her encounter with Daijuuji Kurou, Al slowly opened her heart until she finally developed romantic feelings for him.
